goal: Audit recognizability of classic Twin Peaks locations in current game, with independent Luna reviewers and verifiable visual evidence
externalBar: Original television frames and Richard Hoover production-design photographs; pixel-art briefs are secondary, not television evidence

excluded: Hospital/traincar/other generic sites without a collected reference
immutable: No art fixes authorized in this review
platforms: Production canvas 256x192, desktop; native and integer zoom

sources.type: Original S1/S2 production designer set photographs
Pilot broadcast frames; later location photos explicitly excluded
Published broadcast furnishing frame; exact episode not independently established
S2 opening broadcast frame; low camera, geometry partial

measurements.criterion: Distinctive big shapes, materials/color relations, object relations, recognizable motifs; no penalty for honest top-down compression
Review asks what remains identifiable when ignoring text labels and character identities; NOT a blind human test

fixedConditions.camera: Canonical entrance/spawn where defined; explicit audit setup, not walked entry
fixedConditions.boot: Fresh production index.html per scene via existing A4 probe
fixedConditions.timing: Ambient phase not frozen; only static spatial findings
